label: Golden Circle
text: Influential communication moves from WHY to HOW to WHAT rather than listing features first. A reader learns to make purpose the organizing center before proof points and products.

label: Apple Inc.
text: Apple Inc., founded in 1976 and based in Cupertino, is the recurring Golden Circle case: Macintosh and later products are WHATs made coherent by a challenger identity. Apple Inc. turns Apple Inc. into a concrete test of the unit's central mechanism.

label: Wright brothers
text: Orville Wright and Wilbur Wright flew at Kitty Hawk on December 17, 1903. Their case makes purpose and persistence visible before credentials. Wright brothers turns Wright brothers into a concrete test of the unit's central mechanism.

label: Martin Luther King Jr.
text: Martin Luther King Jr. spoke at the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C. on August 28, 1963. The civil-rights case shows belief attracting people before a policy checklist. Martin Luther King Jr. turns Martin Luther King Jr. into a concrete test of the unit's central mechanism.

label: Apple Inc. makes Golden Circle concrete through Apple Inc. and 1976.
text: Apple Inc. makes Golden Circle concrete through Apple Inc. and 1976. Because Apple Inc. gives the idea a visible setting, the reader can test the claim against behavior instead of accepting a slogan. The safe move is to treat Apple Inc. as colorful background. The case carries the mechanism, so treating it as decoration removes the lesson's evidence.

label: Golden Circle depends on the sequence WHY before HOW.
text: Golden Circle depends on the sequence WHY before HOW. Because the first term frames the second, reversing them makes the visible tactic carry a job it cannot carry alone. Order is stylistic, so any sequence works if the message sounds polished. Order changes diagnosis; a polished tactic cannot repair a wrong premise.

label: WHY, HOW, WHAT form the local framework for The Golden Circle.
text: WHY, HOW, WHAT form the local framework for The Golden Circle. Because each member names a different job, the writer can assign claims to distinct functions rather than blending them. The framework is a slogan and can be shortened to one word. Shortening removes the distinctions the quiz and examples need to test.

label: Cupertino is a hard detail that should stay attached to Apple Inc..
text: Cupertino is a hard detail that should stay attached to Apple Inc.. Because hard specifics are portable only inside their case, moving Cupertino to another example creates false grounding. Any true detail can be reused wherever it sounds useful. A true detail becomes misleading when it is attached to the wrong case.

text: Lincoln Memorial helps mark the boundary of Golden Circle. Because boundary details tell the reader where the idea stops, they prevent overgeneralizing from a single attractive case.
